# Weblio英和和英辞典 (Weblio English-Japanese Dictionary)

> > Comprehensive Japanese-English dictionary and linguistic reference platform offering concordance search, collocation analysis, and corpus-based language learning tools.

Weblio ejje (ejje.weblio.jp) is a leading Japanese online dictionary service that provides English-Japanese translations, concordance searches showing words in context, collocation patterns from authentic corpora, and idiom/phrase databases sourced from authoritative references like Kenkyusha dictionaries. The platform serves language learners, translators, and researchers with corpus linguistics tools for analyzing English word usage and associations.

## Key Topics

- Concordance search
- Collocation analysis
- Corpus linguistics
- English-Japanese translation
- Word associations
- Kenkyusha dictionaries
- Language reference tools
- Idioms and phrases
- Linguistic analysis
- English learning resources
- Context-based examples
- Word usage patterns
- Japanese-English lexicography

## Concordance & Collocation Search

- [「mgt .」の共起表現 - Weblio英語共起表現検索](https://ejje.weblio.jp/concordance/content/mgt+.): Concordance search for 'mgt .' showing collocations with MGT Power
- [「bracketing」の共起表現 - Weblio英語共起表現検索](https://ejje.weblio.jp/concordance/content/bracketing): Concordance search for 'bracketing' showing English collocations
- [「affirmations」の共起表現 - Weblio英語共起表現検索](https://ejje.weblio.jp/concordance/content/affirmations): Concordance search for 'affirmations' with corpus-based collocations
- [「off-target」の共起表現 - Weblio英語共起表現検索](https://ejje.weblio.jp/concordance/content/off-target): Concordance for 'off-target' with examples from Rochester, Kent
- [「chromophores」の共起表現 - Weblio英語共起表現検索](https://ejje.weblio.jp/concordance/content/chromophores): Scientific term 'chromophores' concordance with FRET-related collocations

## Idioms & Phrase Dictionary

- [Master--を含むイディオムやフレーズ - 研究社 新英和中辞典](https://ejje.weblio.jp/phrase/kenej/Master--): English idioms and phrases containing 'Master' from Kenkyusha dictionary
